violation_type.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows Responsibilities (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows Responsibilities
violation_type.typical_finding: It was found during the investigation that at the time of the gas leak the person left in charge of the facility did not follow/know all the steps outlined in their Emergency Preparedness Plan. It was found that the planned evacuation routes for each class were not followed and instead of evacuating to the planned evacuation site stated in their Emergency Preparedness Plan they evacuated to the playground.  It was also found that the gates on the playground were locked, and the employees present at the time of the evacuation did not know the location of the keys to unlock the gates therefore they were unable to exit through the playground gates.

Director did not leave a person in charge in their absence. The deficiency is related to a DFPS Abuse/Neglect investigation.
During the inspection the caregiver in charge did not for how long when licsening inquired.
There was not a qualifying caregiver in charge while the director was away.
Person in charge was unable to get files to be reviewed during the inspection.
A caregiver left in charge failed to notify a parent of an incident that occurred. They also failed to notify their director and Child Care Regulation.
